record.name: Marauder
record.description: Marauders channel sheer brutality—smashing through lines, shaking off punishment, and breaking foes' resolve through overwhelming presence.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Marauders are brutal, aggressive warriors who specialize in melee combat and intimidating their foes.
visual_signals: A Marauder's armor is battered and worn, with visible scratches and dents.
Their facial expressions convey a mix of aggression and intensity.

progression_tree.description: When you deal damage to a creature, you can try to take it down with a brutal takedown. Make an opportunity attack against the target, and if you hit, the target must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
As a bonus action, you can enter a brutalize state. While in this state, your Strength checks deal an additional 2d6 damage.

When a creature you can see makes an attack roll against you, you can make a melee Attack roll against that target. If your attack roll equals or exceeds the target's attack roll, the target is considered to have hit itself instead.
You can use your action to create a resonance effect. You and all creatures within 10 feet of you must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become disoriented for 1 minute.

As an action, you can attempt to overpower a creature. Make a Strength check against the target's Strength saving throw DC. If you succeed, the target is incapacitated and cannot move until it makes a successful Strength (Athletics) check or it takes a short rest.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Marauder assumes a wide-legged stance with their lightsaber at the ready, radiating an aura of intimidation and aggression.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: A dark side energy signature crackles around Marauder's armor, as if the very fabric of the Force is being twisted by their rage.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: Generate a dramatic image of a Marauder charging into battle, lightsaber shining bright in the darkness.
contextual_modifiers: In a dimly lit cave on the planet Zorvath
With an enemy stormtrooper cowering in fear
